name: apc_classic_ac_direct_syscall
description: APC injection against ac_client.exe (install-only; AC's main thread never enters alertable wait).

extra.verify_hits_rationale: AC's main thread uses non-alertable waits (SDL 1.2 Sleep, PeekMessage), so a queued APC never drains during the observation window. This is a real limitation of user-mode APC injection against game loops that don't opt into alertable waits — and precisely why the Early-Bird variant exists (queue the APC pre-main() when NtTestAlert would drain it). For this baseline, we measure install-detectability only.
extra.expected_fingerprint: 1x cross-process OpenProcess (attacker → ac_client.exe with hostile mask), 1x cross-process OpenThread, 1x ALLOCVM_REMOTE (RWX trampoline, ~4KB), 1x WRITEVM_REMOTE (shellcode+counter, 4KB write), 1x KERNEL_THREATINT_TASK_QUEUEUSERAPC. Notably absent: 0x THREAD_CREATE_REMOTE, 0x SETTHREADCONTEXT.
